messages.author: fe3833ae46036c97
messages.subject: cluster extraction
parts:
Dear Kylie,

I need to extract the coordinates of a given cluster and then cut it out and write it to a file. I have such program code, but there is some errors.

 

 

name <- "cropped_HumA"

folder <- "C:/Users/E.Popova/Desktop/brain/MALDI/human_A"

macaque.cerebellum <- readMSIData("C:/Users/E.Popova/Desktop/brain/MALDI/human_A/cropped_HumA.imzML", attach.only=TRUE, as = "MSImagingExperiment", mass.range=c(500,1000))

macaque.cerebellum.cropped1 <- reduceBaseline(macaque.cerebellum.cropped, method = c("median", "locmin"))

mc.cer <- smoothSignal(macaque.cerebellum.cropped1, method = "gaussian")

mc.cer <- peakPick(mc.cer, method = "simple")

mc.cer <- peakAlign(mc.cer)

mc.cer <- peakFilter(mc.cer, freq.min = 0.001)

mc.cer <- process(mc.cer)

mc.cer.clust <- spatialShrunkenCentroids(mc.cer, k=6, r=1, s=1)

image(mc.cer.clust)

writeImzML(mc.cer.clust, file = "C:/Fenta/Kosmos/brain/MALDI", name = "cropped_HumACl0")

cluster_indices <- c(4)

pixels_in_cluster <- mc.cer.clust$classes$`k = 6, r = 1, s = 1` %in% cluster_indices

d_subset <- mc.cer[,pixels_in_cluster]

image(d_subset, mz=866.5, smooth.image="gaussian", contrast.enhance = "histogram")

 

> mc.cer <- process(mc.cer)

Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  :

  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘process’ for signature ‘"MSImageSet"’

 

 

> writeImzML(mc.cer.clust, file = "C:/Fenta/Kosmos/brain/MALDI", name = "cropped_HumACl1") 
writing ibd file 'C:\Users\E.Popova\Documents\cropped_HumACl1.ibd'
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘msiInfo’ for signature ‘"SpatialShrunkenCentroids"’

 

 

pixels_in_cluster is empty.

What commands should I write for the program to work?

Thank you very much for taking the time to reply!

With very best regards,

Elena

messages.author: fa51e47cdd090afc
messages.subject: Re: cluster extraction
parts:
Hi Elena,
can you try these lines when you are isolating the cluster? Maybe it could be a problem with the MSImagingExperiment/MSImageSet formats. They use different internal structures.

cluster_indices <- c(4)
pixels_in_cluster <- mc.cer.clus@resultData@listData[[1]]$class%in%cluster_indices
d_subset <- mc.cer[,pixels_in_cluster]

Try them and let us know if it worked for you.
Regards,
Edu
